ZZTJ.note: Later chronicle that names 奮威 as 孫堅's younger brother's son 瑜, i.e. 孫瑜; the plain-text transcription reads 『奮威者，孫堅弟子奮威將軍、丹楊太守瑜也』.

findings.spoken_text: 他想讓這位將軍留守攻下的新地。
findings.source_text: SZ54 p8:『乞與奮威俱進取蜀，得蜀而并張魯，因留奮威固守其地』；ZZTJ line 5715 identifies 奮威 as 孫瑜.
findings.antecedent: s04046 says 『與奮威將軍孫瑜一道西進』; s04047 intervenes with the next planned action, so 『這位將軍』 still refers plainly to 孫瑜.
findings.visual: hold-west shows a general setting a counter on an unlettered map. It conveys a planned allocation of territory without claiming the conquest occurred. No contradiction.

findings.spoken_text: 這一帶的百姓還沒歸附，需要有人接手安撫。
findings.source_text: SZ54 p21, 〈魯肅傳〉 main text:『劉備近在公安，邊境密邇，百姓未附，宜得良將以鎮撫之。魯肅智略足任，乞以代瑜。』
findings.nuance: 『這一帶』 points back to the nearby border in s04057; the source does not give a precise location for every unaligned household. 『安撫』 is a plain-language rendering of 鎮撫, and 『接手』 is grounded in the proposed replacement in the next sentence.
findings.visual: people-unsettled shows a commander placing a token on a blank border map. It does not depict the civilians but supports the border governance point without contradictory detail.

findings.spoken_text: 上疏最後，他甚至提到自己死去的那一天。
findings.source_text: SZ54 p21, 〈魯肅傳〉 main text ends the memorial:『瑜隕踣之日，所懷盡矣。』
findings.nuance: 隕踣之日 is correctly unpacked as the day of his death; the line marks the end of the main-text memorial before the commentary's second version.
findings.visual: last-words shows the officer looking at a folded petition, matching the memorial context. No claim of readable handwriting or a verified original document.

findings.spoken_text: 那一版寫他路上突患急病，治療後也沒好轉。
findings.source_text: SZ54 p21, Pei's quotation of 《江表傳》:『至以不謹，道遇暴疾，昨自醫療，日加無損。』
findings.attribution: s04063 expressly introduces Pei's quoted 《江表傳》 letter; 『那一版』 keeps this detail out of Chen Shou's main text. 暴疾 and 日加無損 support sudden illness and no recovery.
findings.visual: sudden-illness shows a resting commander beside travel belongings. It depicts illness on the road as an illustration; it does not suggest a diagnosis or tie the old arrow wound to death.

findings.spoken_text: 那封信接著說，人生有死，壽命長短不是他要惋惜的事。
findings.source_text: SZ54 p21, the same 《江表傳》 letter:『人生有死，脩短命矣，誠不足惜，但恨微志未展……』
findings.antecedent: 『那封信』 refers back to the alternate letter named in s04063, not to the main-text memorial; s04064 gives its first new detail, and s04065 continues it.
findings.visual: life-length shows a hand resting on a folded letter. It matches the second letter without claiming visible text or authentic material form.

findings.spoken_text: 還記得南郡那支箭嗎？《周瑜傳》沒把它寫成死因；不能判作舊傷復發。
findings.source_text: SZ54 p6 records the right-rib arrow and serious wound followed by Zhou's return to duty; SZ54 p8 states only 『而道於巴丘病卒』 and supplies no causal link to the arrow. SZ54 p21's main memorial and Pei-quoted variant do not name the arrow as the illness's cause.
findings.causal_limit: The line correctly says the surviving passage does not establish recurrence, while leaving the unknown illness unnamed. It does not claim recurrence is medically impossible.
findings.visual: no-diagnosis shows a history reader with an undecorated book margin. It points to the written evidence and avoids picturing an arrow as the fatal cause.

overall.minor_nuance: s04058's 『這一帶』 should be heard as the frontier just mentioned, not a pinpoint claim about 公安 itself.
overall.narrative_effect: The six edited lines clarify references and primary versus Pei-quoted wording. They do not create a recap or interrupt the illness-to-succession sequence.
